findings.evidence: [REQ-STORE-004]: 'retirement date same day (business day ≤ resigned_date) ... and day-crossing work's retirement grace period (until 12:00 the day after retirement date) ... employment_status=RESIGNED is also authorized as a legitimate business operation'
findings.scenario: Staff resigns on 2026-11-23. System allows clock-in/out on 2026-11-23 and until 2026-11-24 12:00 despite RESIGNED status, preventing unrecorded final shift work.

findings.evidence: [Section 4]: 'regardless of the current value of the membership's employment_status... reliably handed over' AND '[REQ-STORE-003]': 'Set the effective_to... to the day after the retirement date'
findings.scenario: Wage calculation for resignation date successfully retrieves hourly wage from contract history because effective_to is exclusive (resigned_date + 1) and status check is bypassed for handoff.

findings.evidence: [REQ-STORE-003]: 'If the target staff is already in RESIGNED state... Same retirement date... returns 200 OK'
findings.scenario: Network timeout causes retry of resignation request. System returns 200 OK instead of 409 Conflict, ensuring idempotency and preventing user confusion.
